messages.text:
I can’t credit both now:

- **Toothbrush holder:** Our records show it hasn’t arrived back. It must arrive before a refund can be requested. The order’s deadline of **12 November 2026 at 10:00 UTC** has also passed, so a request after it arrives would be late. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)
- **Tumbler:** **BRL 39.90** was already refunded against the original payment, receipt **R-H255-0001**. It cannot be refunded again. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/remaining)

I can’t promise credit before your next bill. This demo’s receipt records a refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer, and the shop gives no arrival date. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
